name: GeoVol — Reservoir Volumetrics
description: A professional-grade geoscience application for calculating OIIP and GIIP from 2D/3D seismic data, multi-file SEG-Y parsing, 3D volume construction from 2D surveys, interactive 3D seismic cube & fence diagram manipulation, automated horizon picking, petrophysics (manual & LAS), and Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis.
